What is Email Hosting ?

Email hosting is a service that provides custom email addresses using a domain name. It ensures security, reliability, and professional communication with advanced features like spam protection, encryption, and cloud storage, making it ideal for businesses and organizations.

Email hosting is a specialized service that allows users to create and manage professional email accounts linked to their domain. It offers enhanced security, high uptime, and advanced management tools, ensuring seamless communication and data protection for businesses and individuals.

Email

Email Hosting Features

Secure, reliable, fast, scalable, encrypted, spam-free, cloud-based, and user-friendly.

Gmail

Gmail offers secure, fast, and user-friendly email services with spam protection, cloud storage, and accessibility.

Calendar

Calendar helps schedule events, set reminders, manage tasks, sync devices, and organize daily activities efficiently.

Meet

Meet enables secure video conferencing, screen sharing, real-time collaboration, chat, and seamless team communication.

Docs

Docs allows real-time collaboration, cloud storage, editing, sharing, formatting, and secure document management online.

Sheets

Sheets offers real-time collaboration, data analysis, charts, automation, cloud storage, and secure spreadsheet management.

Slides

Slides enables real-time collaboration, creative presentations, templates, animations, cloud storage, and seamless sharing options.

Drive

Drive provides secure cloud storage, file sharing, backups, collaboration, accessibility, and seamless device synchronization.

Forms

Forms enables easy survey creation, data collection, real-time collaboration, customization, analytics, and seamless integration.

Chat

Chat enables real-time messaging, file sharing, collaboration, group chats, notifications, and secure communication.

Use the following ports for Email Hosting: IMAP (Port 143 or 993 for secure SSL), POP3 (Port 110 or 995 for secure SSL), and SMTP (Port 25 or 587 for secure SSL).
